# jev-usher

> Open-source model routing and context admission for Claude Code and TypeScript agents, powered by TypeSafe JEV.

jev-usher selects a model at Claude session startup and keeps relevant tool text
with an original copy for recovery. JEV supplies typed judgments; deterministic
policies apply budgets, thresholds, and failure behavior. The local test UI
compares Claude without and with routing plus filtering using a JEV API key and
the installed Claude CLI. JEV calls use TypeSafe's hosted service.

Do not infer savings from selection counts alone. Read the integration and privacy
documents before using the launcher on private work. The launcher chooses the
model only for a new session and keeps Claude's configured model when JEV is
uncertain or unavailable; prompt-hook routing hints remain advisory.
The compaction library does not replace native Claude compaction.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/cvsgireesh/jev-usher/blob/main/README.md): purpose, installation, examples, and limitations.
- [Claude Code setup](https://github.com/cvsgireesh/jev-usher/blob/main/docs/claude-code.md): hooks, explicit inputs, configuration, and recovery.
- [Local test UI](https://github.com/cvsgireesh/jev-usher/blob/main/docs/local-ui.md): live JEV and local Claude comparisons.
- [Measured results](https://github.com/cvsgireesh/jev-usher/blob/main/docs/results.md): whole-run token counts, task checks, recovery costs, and reproduction commands.
- [API reference](https://github.com/cvsgireesh/jev-usher/blob/main/docs/reference.md): TypeScript lenses, configuration, and result types.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/cvsgireesh/jev-usher/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): data flow, resource limits, failure policy, and accounting.
- [Data handling](https://github.com/cvsgireesh/jev-usher/blob/main/docs/privacy.md): provider transmission and local storage.
